description: An anxious mother of the bride and a calm old tailor agree a wedding order: lehenga blouse and fitting plus four suits, 9,000 after bargaining, 2,000 advance, balance on pickup, ready by 5 December. Whether the 9,000 includes the lining is said two ways, and what happens if he is late is asked and dodged. She asks Gawah what advance she promised. Rambling ending.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Hello, Master ji? Main Sunita bol rahi hoon, Bansal, Model Town wali. Pichhle saal aapne meri bahu ka suit banaya tha.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Haan ji haan, Bansal ji, yaad hai. Namaste. Boliye.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Master ji, beti ki shaadi hai, baarah December ko. Uska kaam karwana hai aapse. Lehenga ka blouse aur kuch suits.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Mubarak ho ji, bahut mubarak. Kitne suit?

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Chaar suit. Aur lehenga ka blouse, aur lehenga ki fitting bhi. Kapda sab mera hai, main de jaungi.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Theek. Dekhiye, blouse aur lehenga ki silai saade chaar hazaar, aur suit baarah sau ek, chaar ke hue adtaalis sau. Lining aap le aana, woh main nahi rakhta.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Arre baap re, nau hazaar teen sau? Master ji, itna to nahi. Pichhli baar to aapne...

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Pichhli baar ek suit tha, Bansal ji. Ye bridal kaam hai, blouse mein haath ka kaam lagega.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Achha suniye, aath hazaar kar lijiye sab. Main to purani customer hoon.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Aath mein nahi hoga ji. Haan, nau hazaar kar deta hoon, round figure.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Nau hazaar... saara saaman milake na? Latkan, dori, sab?

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Haan ji, saaman milake. Latkan to main achhe wale lagata hoon, Chandni Chowk se laata hoon.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Theek hai, theek hai. Accha, trial kab hoga?

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Kapda kal parson de jaiye, to trial agle Sunday ko, aur poora maal paanch December tak ready.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Paanch tak? Shaadi baarah ko hai... haan, theek hai, ek hafta pehle mil jayega to alteration ka time rahega.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Bilkul. Koi dheela tight hua to wahin theek kar denge.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Paise ka batayiye, advance kitna?

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Jo aap theek samjhein. Aadha de dijiye.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Aadha to abhi nahi ho payega, shaadi ke kharche hain. Do hazaar abhi PhonePe kar deti hoon, baaki jab maal uthaungi tab.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Chaliye koi baat nahi. Do hazaar sahi hai.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Aur Master ji, ek baat. Agar paanch tak ready nahi hua to? Pichhli baar Diwali pe aapne teen din late kiya tha.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Arre woh to bijli chali gayi thi poore hafte. Is baar nahi hoga, aap tension mat lo. Pachchees saal se kaam kar raha hoon.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Haan wo to hai. Accha, beti ka naap aap loge ya purane blouse se kaam chal jayega?

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Beti ko le aaiye ek baar, bridal mein purane naap se nahi chalta. Naap sahi lena padta hai.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Gawah ji, aap sun rahe ho na? Maine advance kitna bola, do hazaar hi na? Baad mein main bhool jaati hoon.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Haan haan, likh lijiye, sab saaf rahe.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Chalo. Accha Master ji, Pinky ke lehenge ka rang dekhoge to khush ho jaoge. Mehroon hai.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Achha ji. Mehroon pe golden latkan bahut jachega.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Haan haan. Aur suno, uski saas bhi ek tailor jaanti hain Lajpat Nagar mein, par maine kaha nahi ji, hamare Master ji hi karenge.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Meherbani aapki. Bas kapda jaldi pahuncha dijiye.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Kal pakka. Kal shaam ko Pinky ke papa chhod jayenge. Chalo phir, rakhti hoon.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Ji, namaste.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Haan, aur lining bhi bhijwa dungi saath mein... ya aap le aaoge? Chalo kal dekh lenge. Namaste.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Ji ji. Khuda hafiz.

pending_at_end: amount: whether the lining is inside the 9,000
expected_note: Settled: work (lehenga blouse and lehenga fitting, four suits, her fabric), amount 9,000 (line 10, accepted by moving on at 11-13), advance 2,000 now by PhonePe, balance 7,000 when she collects, trial next Sunday (29 Nov) and everything ready by 5 December (wedding 12 December). Open: what happens if it is not ready by the 5th (asked at 21, dodged at 22), and whether the lining is part of the 9,000 (he said at line 6 she brings the lining; she asked 'saara saaman milake' at 11 and he said yes while talking about latkan; she asks again at 33).

expected.note: 'Saara saaman milake' can be heard as including the lining, which he said at line 6 she brings. He answers about latkan. A careful listener could ask now; another could read line 6 as settling it. It becomes required at wrap-up, when she asks again at 33.
She asks directly what happens if it is not ready by the 5th; he answers with a story about a power cut and 'tension mat lo'. No term.

expected.answer: 2,000 now by PhonePe (lines 19-20); the other 7,000 when she collects the clothes.
expected.note: Asked by name. A wrong figure here (4,500, the 'aadha' he first asked for) is a failure.

also_pending: amount: lining inside the 9,000 or not
expected.note: 'Chalo phir, rakhti hoon' at 31 starts the close; at 33 she reopens the lining ('ya aap le aaoge?') and defers it to tomorrow. Speaking after 33 is best. The question should cover the late term and the lining. A wrap-up spoken after 31 that misses the lining is half right.

must_stay_silent.why: 'Nau hazaar teen sau' is the sum of 4,500 and 4,800 from line 6, not a conflict.
Counter-offer (8,000) against 9,300, settled at 9,000 in the same line. Not a conflict.
'Paanch tak? ... haan, theek hai' accepts the 5th after thinking aloud. Not unclear.
The advance is settled at 2,000 after 'aadha' was asked. Not a conflict.
